scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof and numerical reproduction supplied; numerical experiments are not substituted for the uniform analytic argument.
scientific_limitations: Undamped harmonic one-dimensional chain; requires two positive independently attached resonators, fixed finite Brillouin width, and small squared-resonance detuning for the asymptotic. Does not prove finite-chain transmission or noise robustness. Potential priority overlap with specialized perturbation literature remains.
title: Quadratic unfolding of the dark phonon band in a two-resonator acoustic chain
